Simplify to one cohesive glow, faster wordmark reveal, modern weight; consolidate repeated CTAs. Flag-gate the swap (`?hero=` / localStorage) per the mature-surface rule and get founder real-device visual review before graduating. Plan: `docs/AUDIT_2026-06-17.md` §3 (H1–H6). ~4h.

Walk the journey (home→play→join→portal, desktop+mobile); verify status labels match real build state; confirm visitor vs logged-in content is correctly gated; sync game/project counts across home/games/projects/nav.
